name: stol-steps
note: Airframe coverage: the ONE-LAW rule names a low-limit STOL trainer and one has never been flown on a card. Mirrored pairs only - 30 deg az right/left about a -15/+15 datum, 40 deg el down/up about a -20/+20 datum, so an asymmetry shows up as a difference between two equal steps rather than as one absolute number. AIRFRAME: low-limit STOL trainer (alphaLimiter ~10 deg). A jet placed at 90 m/s will mush - see cards/README.md.
